messages:
Maya Chen: Quick quarterly milestone sync — can folks from eng + product confirm what actually shipped vs slipped and call out blockers/deps? Need owners and next steps by EOD Fri. TL;DR: we need to finalize Q2 OKR status for the board deck.

AJ Patel: pinging eng-runtime + infra. I have the high-level shipped list but want to confirm a few things: routing fallback and canary automation.

Kevin Li: Search latency improvements — shipped last week (perf tests green). Owner: Kevin Li. Docs PR merged: https://github.com/redwood/search/pull/412 :tada:

Sophia Gomez: Rollout automation — partial. Canary flow is in prod for 10% but we hit a bug for rollback rule. Owner: Sophia Gomez. Next step: rollback rule fix + validate policy by Wed.

Tom Rogers: Routing fallback feature slipped to next sprint — dependency on model-variant mapping service. Owner: AJ Patel. Reason: mapping API didn't support prefix routing.

AJ Patel: Confirmed — mapping API change required; I put a short RFC in #eng-runtime earlier. Implementation started but needs an infra migration (db index) which slipped because of SRE load.

Maya Chen: Ok — this is a blocker for the OKR "graceful-degradation" metric. Can we get an ETA? If not, we should move the milestone to 'slipped' for the board and call out the dependency.

Kevin Li: ETA for mapping API work? I can help with the index change if SRE bandwidth is the issue. I have a small window Thursday afternoon.

AJ Patel: That would help a lot, Kevin — can you pair with SRE (TomR) Thursday 2pm? If that happens, we can keep routing fallback in "at-risk" rather than fully slipped.

Tom Rogers: 2pm works. I'll create a brief runbook and add the infra checklist.

Sophia Gomez: For rollout automation, I'll open a tiny spike to harden rollback policy and add it to the canary dashboard. Plan: finish by Wed EOD, then ship the policy change Thu morning.

Maya Chen: Great. Two action items: 1) Kevin + Tom pair Thu 2pm to unblock mapping API DB index; 2) Sophia finish rollback policy Wed EOD. If either slips, we mark respective milestones as slipped and call out dependency.

reminder-bot: Friendly reminder — please update the OKR tracker with shipped/slipped status by 5pm Fri. Use the template in #product-ops.

AJ Patel: I'll add a short note to the tracker after pairing and mark routing fallback as "at-risk" for now.

Kevin Li: Added a short PR comment for pairing plan. :+1:

Maya Chen: Thanks everyone — I'll draft the OKR status blurb for the board after Fri EOD. If anything changes before then, drop updates here.

Sophia Gomez: Quick follow-up Qs: should we include a short regression metric for the rollback policy? I can add a one-liner in the tracker.

Maya Chen: Yes please — one-liner with metric and owner. That helps the board Q&A.

Tom Rogers: Created infra checklist -> https://docs.redwood/internal/infra/okrs/mapping-index-checklist. Adding notes now.

AJ Patel: Thanks — closing loop on my side.

Maya Chen: Closing thread for now — will re-open if any slips. :white_check_mark:
